description: Model a subscription price rise: monthly revenue before and after, given how many customers are expected to leave over it, and the share of customers that can be lost before the rise stops paying. Send numbers only (percentages as 5 for 5%). Answers a headline, the figures behind it and notes. Arithmetic on your own numbers, not financial advice. Answers from what you send alone: nothing is fetched or stored.

currency.description: The sign money is written with; "none" for bare numbers. Default "$".

leave.description: Customers you expect to lose over it (%). Your guess at the share who cancel because of the new price. Optional.

name: calculate_price_increase
title: Model a price increase
